description: Twelve NOT gates built for digital signals, which also accept analog ones.

inputs.text: The signal inverted at that gate's output; with nothing patched in the gate reads 0V, which the default 0-10V range treats as low.

outputs.text: Carries a high while the input into that gate is low, and a low while it is high; a gate with nothing patched into its input therefore gives a steady 1V, 5V or 10V.

menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
